concerns.text: The `results.schema.yaml` contract requires the `degradation` field in every row of `results/raw_logs.csv`. The plan’s description of task **T018c** only says it “records per‑round metrics to `results/raw_logs.csv`” and does not specify that the `degradation` column will be populated (or how it will be computed per row). This creates a mismatch between the plan and the data‑model/contract, risking schema validation failures.
